title: PEMAD-ESB-ScalPred: two-stage GAM calibration, abundance and shell-height analysis for automated sea scallop counts
description: R and Python workflow that calibrates object-detector outputs (YOLOv12, Cascade R-CNN, RT-DETR-L) on HabCam imagery with detection-level and image-level generalized additive models, evaluates them on block-structured holdouts and leave-one-year-out tests, and validates automated shell-height measurements.
